issues.description: Method Lecture.toString(): The problem statement and UML expect a toString() that returns a String (described in problem_statement.md). The solution implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) declares '@Override public Object toString()' which uses return type Object instead of String. The template file only contains a TODO for the toString method. Because the solution's signature does not match the expected return type, the @Override annotation is invalid and the class will not compile; this contradicts the problem description and will block students who rely on the solution or compare against it.
issues.suggestedFix: In the solution change the method signature to 'public String toString()' (keeping the @Override annotation) and ensure the method returns a String. Update the solution file src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java accordingly so the method properly overrides Object.toString() and the code compiles, matching the problem statement and UML.
